## Checklist

- [ ] Notes are Markdown and render correctly on GitHub
- [ ] Image links use standard Markdown (`![alt](path/to/image.png)`), not Obsidian `![[image.png]]`
- [ ] New or renamed images use PascalCase (e.g. `WaterfallProcessModel.png`) and live under `assets/<NoteName>/`
- [ ] New course folders include a `README.md`
- [ ] I followed the [Contribution Guide](../CONTRIBUTIONS.md)
